stories.title: OpenAI launches GPT-6 Astra, its first "critical" cyber-capability model
stories.summary: OpenAI has released GPT-6 Astra, a computer-use/agentic model that leadership framed as marking the start of an "AGI era." It's the first OpenAI model to cross the company's Preparedness Framework "critical" cybersecurity threshold — scoring 100% on ExploitBench and finding real zero-days in testing — so its most advanced cyber capabilities are initially limited to trusted defenders via Daybreak Blue. OpenAI committed $1 billion under "Daybreak for Frontline Defenders" to expand access to that frontier cyber AI, plus training and support, for essential services. Astra posts strong benchmark results, though OpenAI's framing has drawn scrutiny over what those numbers measure and the absence of its GDPval real-world-work benchmark. It is rolling out to enterprise, ChatGPT and API customers with tiered pricing and additional monitoring safeguards; early access problems left some paying users unable to use the new model, prompting Sam Altman to apologize and offer usage resets. A separate critique argues that Astra's more advanced, less legible reasoning makes the human oversight OpenAI has championed harder to provide.
